sal.basis: UAE pay is quoted monthly, tax-free, as a total package (basic + housing + transport). Senior Financial Analyst / Senior FP&A, ~8 yrs, Dubai: about AED 25-32k a month at multinationals and 23-28k at SMEs (JobXDubai 2026 salary pages, updated July 2026); Abu Dhabi runs ~5% lower. f = 0.8 maps the v5 Riyadh band 34-41k SAR to AED 27.2-32.8k (centre of the Dubai MNC range), so Ahmed earns ~AED 20,800 and expects ~27,200. KSA pays a premium over the UAE for the same role, which is why f < 1 even though AED and SAR are near par (both USD-pegged, 1 SAR = 0.979 AED).

autoText.en: UAE and GCC nationals can work in the UAE without visa sponsorship.
autoText.ar: مواطنو الإمارات ودول الخليج يقدرون يشتغلون في الإمارات بدون كفالة تأشيرة.
autoText.fr: Les ressortissants émiriens et du CCG peuvent travailler aux Émirats sans parrainage de visa.

rule.en: If your visa is through an employer or you need one, we skip UAE jobs that ask for your own visa.
rule.ar: إذا إقامتك عن طريق جهة عمل أو تحتاج تأشيرة، نتخطّى وظائف الإمارات اللي تطلب إقامة على كفالتك الخاصة.
rule.fr: Si votre visa dépend d'un employeur ou si vous avez besoin d'un visa, nous écartons les offres aux Émirats qui exigent votre propre visa.

desc.en: Private companies with 50 or more staff must add Emiratis to skilled roles every year, reaching 10% by the end of 2026. We only apply to roles marked UAE nationals only if you are Emirati.
desc.ar: الشركات الخاصة اللي فيها 50 موظف أو أكثر لازم تزيد عدد المواطنين في الوظائف المهارية كل سنة لين توصل 10% نهاية 2026. وما نقدّم على الوظائف المخصصة للمواطنين إلا إذا كنت إماراتي الجنسية.
desc.fr: Les entreprises privées de 50 salariés ou plus doivent recruter chaque année des Émiriens sur des postes qualifiés, jusqu'à 10 % fin 2026. Nous ne postulons aux offres réservées aux ressortissants émiriens que si vous avez la nationalité émirienne.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on CVs emailed to recruiters and on regional boards (Bayt, GulfTalent), but UAE CV guides advise leaving it off ATS uploads (Workday, LinkedIn Easy Apply); we offer it and never require it. Gender, date of birth and nationality are standard fields on UAE application forms and regional boards; nationality also drives visa handling and Emiratisation, and recruiters expect visa status on the CV. Marital status: sources conflict and it is not needed, so we do not ask. Decree-Law 33/2021 (Art. 4) bans discrimination on race, colour, sex, religion, national or social origin or disability, while treating Emiratisation measures as lawful, so we never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Emirati-only postings.

legal.law: UAE PDPL (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021); DIFC DP Law 2020 and ADGM DP Regulations 2021 apply in those free zones

privacy.en: Your data is protected under the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). We never share it without your consent.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Dubai. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and got the group ready for UAE Corporate Tax. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, or remote.
bio.ar: محلل مالي بخبرة 8 سنوات في دبي. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات التي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث، وجهّزت المجموعة لضريبة الشركات في الإمارات. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في دبي أو أبوظبي أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Dubaï. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et préparé le groupe à l'impôt sur les sociétés émirien. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Dubaï, à Abou Dhabi ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Mon-Fri since 2022 (federal government moved; most private employers followed; Sharjah government runs Mon-Thu). Salaries are quoted monthly, tax-free, as a package (basic + housing + transport allowances) and paid monthly through the Wage Protection System (WPS), usually at month end. Notice: Decree-Law 33/2021 sets 30-90 days by contract; 30 days is most common, senior roles often 60-90; employers like immediate joiners. No NOC is needed to change jobs in most cases; the new employer issues the work permit and visa. CVs: 2 pages, English, visa status and notice period near the top, nationality listed; photo common on emailed CVs but optional; DOB often listed. Cover letters rarely required; a short intro email or LinkedIn message is normal. Arabic is a plus (often 'Arabic speaker preferred'), English is the working language. Ramadan shortens working hours by 2 hours a day in the private sector. Recruiters and hiring managers are a mix of Emiratis and expats (Arab, South Asian, Western).
